Hi Olivia / Rahul —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned on the POC scope and timeline. Please confirm or propose edits.

High-level objective:
- Validate Redwood Inference for clinical-document summarization and secure private deployment patterns (VPC + KMS).

Success criteria (customer-sourced + measurable):
- Accuracy: automated summaries meet your internal QA score baseline (F1-ish surrogate) >= 0.85 on the sample set you shared.
- Latency: median response <200ms for 512-token requests under expected load.
- Throughput: support sustained 50 qps during synthetic workload.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence collected and KMS integration validated.
- Cost target: unit inference cost in pilot <= $0.02 per 1k tokens (ballpark).

Proposed POC plan (4 weeks):
- Kickoff (Week 0): Mar 8 — project review, access, and data handoff.
- Week 1: Baseline run & integration — sample inputs, baseline metrics, deployment in your VPC test account.
- Week 2: Performance tuning — batching, quantization suggestions, kernel selection.
- Week 3: Scenario tests & stability — heavy synthetic load, failover checks.
- Final readout (Week 4): Mar 29-30 — results, go/no-go decision, next-steps.

Owners (proposed):
- Commercial/PM: Ben Carter (me) — overall schedule, commercial success criteria.
- SE / Integration: Aisha Rahman — infra, VPC/KMS setup, metrics dashboard.
- CS / Ops: Camila Reyes — onboarding, runbook, run-of-show for final readout.
- Customer technical lead: Rahul Desai — API access, whitelist, internal test datasets.

Logistics / asks for this week:
1) Olivia / Rahul: confirm kickoff date or propose alternatives (I suggested Mar 8).
2) Customer to grant test role + repo access for Aisha and a service account for Redwood.
3) I’ll share an initial POC project plan and a SOC2 checklist attachment.

I attached a simple POC_ProjectPlan_v1.xlsx and SOC2-Checklist.pdf to this thread.

If this looks good I’ll lock dates and send calendar invites.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
